bugs_found.description: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable when calling pulso.load(..., allow_unvalidated=True) for any period with checksum_sha256=null in sources.json. In downloader.py line 84: `short = checksum[:16]` where checksum is None.
bugs_found.evidence: Reproducible on 2020-06, 2023-03, 2024-03, 2024-04, 2025-01, 2025-06, 2026-01, 2026-02. All unvalidated periods have checksum_sha256=null. Error: TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not subscriptable at pulso/_core/downloader.py line 84.
bugs_found.fix_hint: In downloader.py: `short = checksum[:16] if checksum else 'no-checksum'` (or handle None before slicing)

bugs_found.description: Excessive 'Skipping variable' warnings during harmonization on epoch2 data. Variables declared in variable_map.json for geih_2021_present (sexo->P3271, edad->P6040, condicion_actividad->DSI, etc.) are not found in module DataFrames. This happens on ocupados and other modules for 2024-06 (validated).
bugs_found.evidence: Running pulso.load(2024, 6, 'ocupados') prints 32+ 'Skipping variable' lines to stdout. Verified on 2022-01 ocupados as well. Variables like P3271, P6040, P6050, P6070, DSI, OCI, INGLABO, RAMA2D_R4, OFICIO_C8 claimed missing from ocupados DataFrame even though INGLABO, RAMA2D_R4, OFICIO_C8 ARE present in the raw data.
bugs_found.fix_hint: Review variable_map.json - some canonical variables require columns from MULTIPLE modules (e.g., condicion_actividad needs DSI which is only in a different module). The harmonizer should not warn when skipping multi-module cross-references.

bugs_found.description: R utils::unzip() fails with 'invalid multibyte string' when ZIP file contains files with non-ASCII filenames (UTF-8 accented characters: 'Características' -> '<a1>sti', 'Migración' -> '<a2>n.C'). Affects 'caracteristicas_generales' and 'migracion' modules across ALL tested epoch2 periods (2022-01, 2023-03, 2024-06, 2025-01).
bugs_found.evidence: Error: 'invalid multibyte string at <a1>sti' for caracteristicas_generales (2015-06, 2022-01, 2023-03, 2024-06, 2025-01). Error: 'invalid multibyte string at <a2>n.C' for migracion (2022-01, 2023-03, 2024-06, 2025-01). Windows locale issue with utils::unzip on UTF-8 filenames.
bugs_found.fix_hint: Use a ZIP library that supports UTF-8 filenames on Windows (e.g., use zip::unzip from the 'zip' package instead of utils::unzip, or rename target files before extraction).

bugs_found.description: R pulso_load() fails for ALL epoch1 modules (geih_2006_2020) with 'numbers of columns of arguments do not match' in rbind(). This makes the R package completely unusable for epoch1 data spanning 2007-2021.
bugs_found.evidence: Reproduced on 2007-12 (validated), 2015-06 (validated), 2021-12 (validated), 2007-01, 2010-06, 2013-01, 2018-09. All modules fail. Error: 'numbers of columns of arguments do not match' at pulso_load -> .parse_module_csv -> rbind -> rbind. Root cause: epoch1 ZIPs contain multiple CSV files (one per city/area) with different column counts; rbind() fails when column counts differ.
bugs_found.fix_hint: In .parse_module_csv: use data.table::rbindlist(fill=TRUE) or dplyr::bind_rows() instead of base rbind() to handle mismatched columns across CSV files in the ZIP.

bugs_found.description: R pulso_load() returns a 1-column DataFrame for some epoch2 modules where the CSV uses a separator other than comma. The entire row becomes a single column name (joined by separator). Observed for ocupados, desocupados, inactivos, otros_ingresos, otras_formas_trabajo in 2022-01.
bugs_found.evidence: pulso_load(2022, 1, 'ocupados'): shape=[31819, 1]. Column name is 'directorio_secuencia_p_orden_hogar_p3044_p6440_...' (200+ fields joined by underscore/tab). Same modules load correctly for 2024-06 (200 cols) suggesting the CSV separator changed between some epoch2 periods or a specific ZIP structure issue.
bugs_found.fix_hint: In .read_single_csv_from_zip: use read.csv(..., sep=NULL) or auto-detect separator with readLines() before reading. The underscore in the merged column name suggests the actual separator might be a tab or semicolon in 2022-01 files.

bugs_found.description: R pulso_load() has NO validation guard for unvalidated periods. It downloads and loads data for any period regardless of validated=false status. Python correctly raises DataNotValidatedError.
bugs_found.evidence: pulso_load(2023, 3, 'ocupados') returns 31009 x 200 DataFrame without error or warning. pulso_load(2025, 1, 'ocupados') returns 28317 x 202 DataFrame. pulso_load(2026, 1, 'ocupados') downloads and returns 28359 x 208. No DataNotValidatedError raised.
bugs_found.fix_hint: Add validation check in pulso_load: if sources entry has validated=FALSE, stop with pulso_validation_error unless allow_unvalidated=TRUE parameter is passed.

bugs_found.description: 2024-03 and 2024-04 (nested-zip periods) cannot be loaded. R gives correct informative error. Python crashes with TypeError (BUG-001) before reaching nested-zip detection logic.
bugs_found.evidence: R error: 'Period 2024-03 uses a nested-zip layout (CSV.zip wrapper) that is not yet supported in pulso v0.1.0. Planned for v0.2.0.' Python error: TypeError NoneType not subscriptable (BUG-001 masks). Documented as known limitation in R (v0.2.0 planned).
bugs_found.fix_hint: Python: fix BUG-001 first. Then ensure nested-zip detection runs before download completes. R: known, planned for v0.2.0.

bugs_found.description: R pulso_load(harmonize=TRUE) does NOT add canonical harmonized column names to the output DataFrame. Python adds 5-13 canonical columns (cotiza_pension, departamento, hogar_id, horas_trabajadas_sem, ingreso_laboral, ocupacion, peso_expansion, peso_expansion_persona, posicion_ocupacional, rama_actividad, tiene_contrato, tipo_contrato, area). R with harmonize=TRUE adds zero canonical columns.
bugs_found.evidence: Python 2024-06 ocupados: 213 cols (200 raw + 13 canonical). R 2024-06 ocupados: 200 cols (all raw). Python 2024-06 desocupados: 46 cols (37 raw + 9 canonical). R: 37 cols. Col counts match on p_coded (182 for ocupados) confirming raw data is same. The 'harmonize=TRUE' parameter in R is documented but has no visible effect on output.
bugs_found.fix_hint: Implement canonical column mapping in R .apply_harmonization() function to add lowercase canonical columns alongside raw columns, matching Python behavior.

bugs_found.description: pulso.list_variables() and pulso.describe_variable() raise NotImplementedError('Phase 2'). These functions are in the public API (in __all__) but not implemented.
bugs_found.evidence: import pulso; pulso.list_variables() raises error 'Phase 2'. pulso.describe_variable('sexo') raises error 'Phase 2'. R equivalents (pulso_list_variables, pulso_describe_variable) work correctly.
bugs_found.fix_hint: Either implement the functions or remove from __all__ / raise clear NotImplementedError with guidance.

bugs_found.description: 2025-06, 2026-01, 2026-02: R cannot find 'Características generales...' and 'Migración' CSV files inside the ZIP (file not found error, different from the encoding error on earlier periods). DANE appears to have changed internal ZIP structure after 2025-01.
bugs_found.evidence: R 2025-06 caracteristicas_generales: 'Expected file CSV/Características generales, seguridad social en salud y educación.CSV not found inside zip 06.zip'. Same for 2026-01 and 2026-02. 2025-01 shows encoding error (different lookup path). The ZIP structure may differ for semi-annual vs monthly releases.
bugs_found.fix_hint: Update sources.json module file path lookups for periods >= 2025-06. May require re-scraping the catalog to get correct internal filenames.
